description: Tests over 1 s in the unit, contract and integration tiers, each with the reason it is slow. An entry leaves when its test is fast; none is added without a reason and an owner step in the open items of the target architecture.

tests.reason: Encodes and stores a Relay of 1,000s of records to prove commit cost; CPU bound by the size under test.

tests.test: packages/agent-relay-cloudflare/test/storage-incremental.test.ts > a commit costs what it changes, not the size of the Relay

tests.reason: Builds a journal of 200,000 items to prove contiguity and paging at scale; CPU bound by the size under test.

tests.reason: Builds a journal of 200,000 items to prove contiguity and paging at scale; CPU bound by the size under test.

tests.test: packages/agent-remote-lab/src/App.succession.ask-and-reconnect.test.tsx > edits a real App managed Team window into its retained origin owner and admits input only to the successor
tests.reason: Waits out the Team menu's real roster poll: while a member's conversation is open the roster is read every 4 s (TEAM_REFRESH_MS, a setInterval in TeamMenu.tsx), and the successor's seat appears only at the next read, about 3.5 s after the commit notification. The App mount over the fixture's loopback Relay and the other steps take about 0.6 s. Kept as Team composition (docs/current/agent-remote/workbench-state.md); it leaves when the poll interval is an input the test can advance.

tests.test: packages/agent-remote-lab/src/App.render-budget.test.tsx > switching bots renders the conversations that change and leaves the others alone
tests.reason: Mounts the whole Workbench with 12 groups of 10 bots over the bot-mode fixture and counts renders through a change: stage 6's render budget is a property of the composed page, which no unit owns (kept as composition, docs/current/agent-remote/workbench-state.md). The mount and the renders of 120 views take about 0.85 s, and real settle waits add 0.55 s (100 ms after each of four bot switches, 50 ms after each of three counted changes). It leaves when those waits run on the fake clock and the budget is shown on a smaller page.

tests.test: packages/agent-remote-lab/src/App.attach-budget.test.tsx > asks for a missing session once across mode switches, state frames, bot switches, page resumes and an access pause
tests.reason: Mounts the whole Workbench in Bot mode and drives a missing session through mode switches, ten state frames, six bot switches, a page resume and an access pause, counting the attaches: stage 7's attach budget is a property of the composed page (kept as composition, docs/current/agent-remote/workbench-state.md). Two real settle waits take 0.5 s (200 and 300 ms) and the mount and the steps about 0.55 s; it leaves when those waits run on the fake clock.
